acquisition_method.evidence: Eluted peptides were analyzed using data-independent acquisition mode on the mass spectrometer.

alkylation_concentration.evidence: After cooling to room temperature, 20 mM IAA (10 μl of 100 mM stock made in milli-Q water) was added and incubated at room temperature for 30 min at 1200 rpm on a ThermoMixer.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: Alkylate nonoxidized sulfhydryl groups with 100 mM indole-3-acetic acid [IAA; final concentration, 20 mM; prepared in 40 mM triethylammonium bicarbonate (TEABC) (pH 8.5)] in the dark at room temperature with shaking at 1000 rpm.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Trypsinization and peptide elution were performed using the S-Trap microcolumn as per the manufacturer’s protocol (Protifi, C02-micro-80).
Digest with 200 ng of trypsin Lys-C and incubate at 30°C for 16 hours without shaking.

collision_energy.evidence: Set HCD normalized collision energy to 30%.

enrichment_method.evidence: For LC-MS analysis, 3.5 mg of cell lysate was used for immunoprecipitation with 25 μl of streptavidin magnetic beads (Pierce, 88817) for 2 hours at 4°C with gentle rotation.

fragmentation_method.evidence: Select the most intense ions above an intensity threshold of 5000 for higher-energy collision dissociation (HCD) fragmentation.

ionization_type.evidence: Separate peptides on an EASY-Spray column (C18, 2 μM, 75 μm by 50 cm) with an integrated nano-electrospray emitter at a flow rate of 300 nl/min.

mass_analyzer.evidence: Analyze the eluted peptides using an Orbitrap Lumos (Thermo Fisher Scientific) mass spectrometer.

ptm.value: No PTMs are included in the dataset

ptm.normalization_matched_text: modified residue with neutral loss of phosphate

reduction_concentration.evidence: In a low-binding tube, reduce the proteins by adding 100 mM TCEP (final concentration, 5 mM) and incubate at 56°C for 30 min on a ThermoMixer.

For reduction, the bead pellet was resuspended in 50 μl of 5% SDS-TEABC (12.5 μl of 20% SDS and 40 μl of 50 mM TEABC) and 5 mM TCEP [2.5 μl of 100 mM stock prepared in 50 mM TEAB (pH 8.5)] and incubated at 60°C for 30 min at 1200 rpm on a ThermoMixer with lid.
